question: With reference to cost, what is the full form of SMC from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Short run marginal cost__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When **more production** is **generated in the short term** but some **costs are fixed,** the overall cost changes. This is known as the **short-run marginal cost.**
 
• The **short-run marginal cost forms a U-shape on the right side **of the page, with **quantity on the x-axis and cost per unit on the y-axis.**
 
• Some of the **company's short-term costs** are** fixed regardless of the output level** (e.g. buildings, machinery).
 
• Other **costs, like labour and materials, fluctuate with output **and are therefore reflected in marginal cost.
 
• If the additional cost per unit is considerable and the firm works at a low level of output, the marginal cost may first decrease as shown in the diagram, start flat, or quickly climb.
 
• The marginal cost **eventually grows as the pressure** on **fixed assets like building size from rising variable input costs like labour increases.**
